title: Markovian Nonconvex ADMM for Reinforcement Learning: Bellman-Resolvent Stability Beyond Smooth Blocks
abstract: arXiv:2609.36859v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We identify and study a structural mechanism for Markovian nonconvex ADMM in reinforcement learning. Using finite discounted MDPs as a canonical proving ground, we show that the discounted Bellman resolvent $(I-\gamma P_\pi)^{-1}$ can provide the multiplier stability that classical nonconvex ADMM analyses often obtain from a designated smooth block. Starting from this mechanism, we establish convergence under controlled Markov sampling and then under stochastic observations using an empirical Bellman surrogate that jointly represents the random residual and its Jacobian. Markov mixing, initialization drift, observation noise, and decaying bias enter as one operator perturbation, avoiding unbiased product and double sampling requirements. When the perturbations are square summable, the true KKT residual converges almost surely to zero. translated_abstract: 我们识别并研究了强化学习中马尔可夫非凸ADMM的一种结构性机制。以有限折扣马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）作为典型验证平台，我们证明了折扣贝尔曼预解 $(I-\gamma P_\pi)^{-1}$ 能够提供经典非凸ADMM分析通常依赖指定光滑模块才能获得的乘子稳定性。基于这一机制，我们在受控马尔可夫采样下建立了收敛性，随后在随机观测下，利用联合表示随机残差及其雅可比矩阵的经验贝尔曼代理同样建立了收敛性。马尔可夫混合、初始化漂移、观测噪声与衰减偏差作为一个统一的算子扰动进入分析，从而避免了无偏乘积与双重采样的要求。当扰动平方可和时，真实的KKT残差几乎必然收敛于零。在有限条件四阶矩条件下，一个伴随迭代满足（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 本文揭示了强化学习中折扣贝尔曼预解 $(I-\gamma P_\pi)^{-1}$ 可替代经典非凸ADMM分析所需的光滑模块来提供乘子稳定性，由此在马尔可夫采样与随机观测下建立收敛性，并将各类噪声统一为算子扰动，在扰动平方可和时保证真实KKT残差几乎必然收敛于零。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the discounted Bellman resolvent $(I-\gamma P_\pi)^{-1}$ can substitute for the smooth block in classical nonconvex ADMM analyses to provide multiplier stability, establishing convergence under Markovian sampling and stochastic observations via a unified operator perturbation framework, with the true KKT residual converging almost surely to zero when perturbations are square summable.
